submittedPrompt: 绘制并排三个独立完整的窄网页文章详情区域，宽比例390、320、320，白灰蓝细边框，正文内可纵向滚动，不重复全局导航。每列文章信息、小标题让知识保持可用、状态徽章；关联原稿/示例笔记、可用编辑原稿。左草稿，状态文章信息已保存，可预览并手动发布；保存文章信息禁用、预览文章可用、发布文章蓝可用。表单完整：标题与摘要分组，文章标题=让知识保持可用，摘要=用于示例的隔离发布快照。；分类与标签分组，提示分类用于主题归档；多个标签用逗号分隔。，分类=方法、标签=知识, 记录；展开封面、置顶与固定链接：封面图片空输入占位笔记中的图片路径（可选）、说明发布时会固定图片副本，请使用你有权公开的图片。；上传并裁切封面、选择图片按钮、从原稿附件中选择封面；置顶文章未勾；固定链接/blog/ knowledge-example，可编辑，复制图标禁用，提示首次发布前可编辑，使用小写英文、数字与连字符。；下方站点尚未开启：发布后仍需在站点设置中开启公开访问。图形预览会在发布时生成。；移除选稿、还未公开发布。中已发布且徽章有更新待发布，提示原稿或文章信息已有变化，线上仍保留上次发布的版本。；状态文章信息有未保存修改，请先保存后发布，保存文章信息可用、预览文章和发布更新禁用；保留与左相同完整字段、封面上传控件、空封面和置顶未选；固定链接knowledge-example只读，复制图标可用，提示首次公开后固定，修改标题不会改变文章地址。；下方保留同站点未开启提示、下架文章、移除选稿、上次发布于2026/11/4。右为同已发布文章读取中，字段保留，顶部红色暂时无法读取文章，请重新核对。及可用重新核对；提示正在核对文章，当前预览与修改会保留…；状态文章信息有未保存修改，请先保存后发布，保存文章信息/预览文章/发布更新全禁用，但文章标题/摘要/分类/标签仍白色可编辑，编辑原稿仍可用；封面、置顶与固定链接折叠，不画额外摘要字段或覆盖发布承诺。没有打开文章预览或上传文件窗口，不加虚假封面缩略图。

sourceContracts.title: 博客管理：文章发布信息
permissionRules: Owner session required for /api/blog; no anonymous management surface. Publication snapshots and site enabled state remain independently controlled.

fields.name: title
fields.constraints: UI maxlength200; API trimmed nonempty <=256 Unicode codepoints

fields.name: category
fields.constraints: max80; optional datalist from existing article categories

fields.name: tags
fields.constraints: UI max600 total; comma/Chinese-comma split trimmed unique tags; API <=30 tags each<=80

fields.name: slug
fields.constraints: lowercase alphanumeric segments joined by hyphens; API<=100; unique/reserved checks; locked after first publication

actions.label: 保存文章信息
actions.effect: CAS update metadata then reread detail

actions.label: 编辑原稿
actions.effect: Navigate owner note editor without rewriting source

actions.label: 发布文章 / 发布更新
actions.effect: Reread and validate source/version, render static diagrams, publish snapshot

responsive.supported: Source-defined responsive layout; not runtime-verified in this read-only inventory
responsive.behavior: <=860px article list/detail and taxonomy become one column, list retains bounded scroll and stats become two columns; <=680px smaller padding/actions, <=720px compact header (blog-admin.css:1082). Runtime unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: A concrete page with its own content, action hierarchy and business state; include in the GPT Image 2 review queue before implementation.
notes: Selection is component state; no article-id URL parameter implemented by navigation.ts. Online snapshot changes only through explicit publish, not note save or metadata save.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.

selfInspection.method: Actual native generated PNG viewed against all input images and exact source template/conditional state contracts.
concerns: Static raster is not proof of executed actions, owner/recipient permissions, focus/keyboard, guard enforcement, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Light raster shading and approximate geometry are illustrative; exact source labels and shared flat CSS tokens remain implementation requirements.
